Load the prerequisites 
```{r}
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 0. Robust Package Installation and Loading
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 1. Define the list of packages needed for the analysis
required_packages <- c(
  "tidyverse", # For data manipulation and plotting
  "haven",     # To read SAS data
  "geepack",   # For GEE models
  "lme4",      # For GLMMs
  "emmeans",   # For predicted probabilities (LSMeans)
  "broom",     # For tidying model output
  "here"       # For setting correct path
)

# 2. Loop through the list: Check -> Install (if needed) -> Load
for (pkg in required_packages) {
  # require() returns TRUE if installed, FALSE if not
  if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE)) { 
    message(paste("Installing missing package:", pkg))
    install.packages(pkg, dependencies = TRUE)
    library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}

message("All required packages are installed and loaded.")
```


```{r}

# 0. Load Data
setwd("./dataset")
alz_wide <- read_sas("alzheimer25.sas7bdat")
# Assuming the SAS dataset is saved locally
# alz_wide <- read_sas("Data/alzheimer25.sas7bdat")

# 1. Construct long-format dataset
alz_long2 <- alz_wide %>%
    mutate(
        abpet_0 = abpet0,
        taupet_0 = taupet0
    ) %>%
  # Convert wide to long using regex to capture variable name and time
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("(bprs|cdrsb|abpet|taupet)[0-6]"),
    names_to = c(".value", "time"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)(\\d+)" 
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    time = as.numeric(time),
    # Convert key categorical variables to factors immediately
    patid = as.factor(patid),
    sex = as.factor(sex),
    abpet0 = abpet_0,
    taupet0 = taupet_0
    ) %>%
  # Keep specific columns (dplyr::select)
  select(patid, trial, sex, age, edu, bmi, inkomen, job, adl, wzc,
         abpet0, taupet0, abpet, taupet, time, BPRS = bprs, CDRSB = cdrsb)

# View structure
str(alz_long2)
```

Explore Missingness
```{r}
# 2.1 Create missingness indicator
alz_long2_miss <- alz_long2 %>%
  mutate(missing_cdrsb = ifelse(is.na(CDRSB), 1, 0))

# 2.2 Frequency table (Time * Missing)
table(alz_long2_miss$time, alz_long2_miss$missing_cdrsb)

# 2.3 Proportion missing per time
miss_summary <- alz_long2_miss %>%
  group_by(time) %>%
  summarise(prop_missing = mean(missing_cdrsb))

# Plot: Proportion missing
ggplot(miss_summary, aes(x = time, y = prop_missing)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1)) +
  labs(title = "Proportion of missing CDRSB by visit year",
       y = "Proportion missing CDRSB", x = "Visit year") +
  theme_minimal()
```


Create binary outcome
```{r}
# 3. Create binary outcome
alz_long2_bin <- alz_long2 %>%
  # Drop missing outcomes
  filter(!is.na(CDRSB)) %>%
  # Binary outcome: 1 = severe (>10), 0 = non-severe
  mutate(
    CDRSBbin = ifelse(CDRSB > 10, 1, 0),
    time_num = time # time is already numeric from step 1
  )

# Check distribution
table(alz_long2_bin$CDRSBbin, alz_long2_bin$time_num)
```


Descriptive plot
```{r}
# 4.1 Compute proportion severe
prop_severe <- alz_long2_bin %>%
  group_by(time_num) %>%
  summarise(prop_1 = mean(CDRSBbin))

# 4.2 Plot
ggplot(prop_severe, aes(x = time_num, y = prop_1)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkred") +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(prop_1, accuracy = 0.1)), vjust = -0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1)) +
  labs(title = "Proportion of severe CDRSB (CDRSBbin=1 ; >10) by visit year",
       y = "Proportion with CDRSBbin = 1", x = "Visit year") +
  theme_minimal()
```


# Marginal models
## Additive Model and Working Correlation Structure
```{r}
# 5.1 Base GEE model: Exchangeable correlation
gee_base <- geeglm(CDRSBbin ~ time_num + age + sex + bmi,
                   id = patid,
                   data = alz_long2_bin,
                   family = binomial,
                   corstr = "exchangeable")

summary(gee_base)

# Calculate Odds Ratios (Exponentiate coefficients)
exp(coef(gee_base))


# 5.2 Full GEE model: Exchangeable
gee_full <- geeglm(CDRSBbin ~ time_num + age + sex + bmi + adl + abpet0 + taupet0,
                   id = patid,
                   data = alz_long2_bin,
                   family = binomial,
                   corstr = "exchangeable")

summary(gee_full)
exp(coef(gee_full)) # ORs


# 5.3 Sensitivity: AR(1) Correlation
gee_ar1 <- geeglm(CDRSBbin ~ time_num + age + sex + bmi + adl + abpet0 + taupet0,
                  id = patid,
                  data = alz_long2_bin,
                  family = binomial,
                  corstr = "ar1")

summary(gee_ar1)
```

# Random effects models
```{r}
# 6.1 Base GLMM
glmm_base <- glmer(CDRSBbin ~ time_num + age + sex + bmi + (1 | patid),
                   data = alz_long2_bin,
                   family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                   nAGQ = 1) # Laplace approximation

summary(glmm_base)


# 6.2 Full GLMM
glmm_full <- glmer(CDRSBbin ~ time_num + age + sex + bmi + adl + abpet0 + taupet0 + (1 | patid),
                   data = alz_long2_bin,
                   family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                   nAGQ = 1)

summary(glmm_full)
```


Empirical BE Random Intercepts
```{r}
# 7.1 Extract Random Effects
re_df <- ranef(glmm_full)$patid
names(re_df) <- "EB_Intercept"
re_df$patid <- rownames(re_df) # Make ID a column

# 7.2 Distribution Histograms and QQ Plots
# Histogram
ggplot(re_df, aes(x = EB_Intercept)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), bins = 30, fill = "lightgrey", color = "black") +
  stat_function(fun = dnorm, args = list(mean = mean(re_df$EB_Intercept), sd = sd(re_df$EB_Intercept)), color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Empirical Bayes random intercepts (GLMM)") +
  theme_minimal()

# QQ Plot
ggplot(re_df, aes(sample = EB_Intercept)) +
  stat_qq() +
  stat_qq_line() +
  labs(title = "QQ Plot of Random Intercepts")


# 7.3 Relationship between EB intercept and Baseline Age
# Merge random effects back with baseline data (time == 0)
baseline_data <- alz_long2_bin %>%
  filter(time_num == 0) %>%
  select(patid, age)

eb_merged <- left_join(re_df, baseline_data, by = "patid")

# Scatter plot with Loess
ggplot(eb_merged, aes(x = age, y = EB_Intercept)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess") +
  labs(y = "EB random intercept (log-odds)", x = "Age at baseline",
       title = "EB random intercepts vs Age") +
  theme_minimal()
```


Predicted probabilities 
```{r}
# Calculate predicted probabilities (response scale)
pred_probs <- emmeans(glmm_full, ~ time_num, type = "response",
                      at = list(time_num = 0:6)) %>%
              as.data.frame()

# Plot
ggplot(pred_probs, aes(x = time_num, y = prob)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL), alpha = 0.2) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1)) +
  labs(x = "Years since baseline", y = "Predicted probability of CDRSBbin = 1",
       title = "Subject-specific predicted probability over time") +
  theme_minimal()
```
